text:
mike: Heads up — main CI started failing around the last merge, ~20 cache-related flakes across linux and mac runners. Failing tests show cache miss assertions in kv_store_test and several e2e timeouts. anyone else seeing this? :confused:
ci-bot: Build 1844999998 failed on main: 12 tests failed, flaky-rate spike, recent commits: .../PR#5893 (jen) changed cache key hashing
anya: oof. can we get the last-green commit hash? need to know where to start the hunt.
mike: last green on main was 9f3b7e4 (yesterday morning). Merged PRs since then: #5893 (jen) and #5896 (ops): upgrade cache proto
devon: I can bisect. will try to narrow to commit range. can someone repro the kv_store_test locally? what's the minimal command?
sara: repro locally with env: `CI_REPRO=1 CI_CACHE=1` then `bazel test //tests/kv:kv_store_test --test_output=errors` — add `--runs_per_test=10` to catch flakes.
leo: Also note: the failures look like cache-invalidation race (cache key normalization changed). Suspect PR#5893.
mike: tagging @jen in case she has context. :eyes: 
jen: saw the tag — I changed the key format to include tenant id to fix cross-tenant collisions. didn't hit failures in staging though.
devon: starting bisect now. plan: git bisect start main 9f3b7e4 && git bisect run ./tools/ci/bisect-runner.sh --target tests/kv:kv_store_test --env CI_CACHE=1
devon: (few mins later) bisect narrowed to range 9f3b7e4..HEAD, suspect commit 3a7c2d9 (PR#5893) — reproduces reliably with `--runs_per_test=50` locally.
mike: nice. can we create a revert PR asap? if it's the one adding tenant id to key maybe we can adjust format instead of revert?
jen: I can open a fix PR to make the key stable during concurrent writes — will push a patch in ~30m. if not ready faster to revert, tell me.
anya: ops perspective: if CI stays red we should block merges. I'll add a temporary branch protection rule locking main until resolved.
sara: re-run of affected CI matrix after clearing caches: started. If green, might be transient. if still red, revert.
ci-bot: Re-run triggered: build 1845000280
devon: after jen's patch landed locally, tests pass with `--runs_per_test=100`. will run full CI run now.
ci-bot: Build 1845001800 completed — linux/mac green on kv tests. other flakes fixed.
mike: sweet. jen — can you open the PR with the fix + a short note about key stability and a test that asserts format compatibility?
jen: will do. opening PR now: https://repo/pulls/5901
leo: once PR is up, can we add a small eval to catch multi-tenant cache regressions in our CI e2e suite?
mike: yes — devex, add a quick integration check. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. closing hunt.
jen: thanks — sorry for the regression, added more unit tests in the PR.
anya: +1 to the fix and the tests. main unblocked now. :thumbsup:
